Title: Question to LSJ about Sibyl's Tongue

Messages.Author: Dave the Romantic
Messages.Body:
I haven't been able to find this question asked/answered anywhere, but
it came up recently...

Name: Sibyl's Tongue
[BH:R2]
Cardtype: Action
Clan: Malkavian antitribu
Cost: X blood
+1 stealth action.
This action costs X blood, where X is the number of Sibyl's Tongues in
your ash heap. Choose a card by name. Search your library for a copy of
that card, show it to all players, and move it to your hand. Discard
down to your hand size and shuffle your library afterward.

The very first time you play this card (and before any are in the ash
heap), the card costs zero pool, correct?
Thanks in advance,
Dave the Romantic

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 30 Dec 2004 20:57:46 +1100, salem <salem_ch...@hotmail.com>
wrote:

>> The very first time you play this card (and before any are in the ash
>> heap), the card costs zero pool, correct?
>
> uh, yeah. what else might it cost?

Umm... One, for the copy you just played (and sent immediately to the ash
heap).

Remember, you only pay the cost when the action is complete. By that time
the
card is already in the ash heap (it was placed there when the action was
announced).

--
Bye,

Daneel

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> >> The very first time you play this card (and before any are in the ash

> >

> heap).
>
> Remember, you only pay the cost when the action is complete. By that
> time the card is already in the ash heap (it was placed there when the
> action was announced).
>

Nope. An action card that generated the current action is neither in play
nor in your hand nor in the ash heap. It's "somewhere else."
